page.layout: One printed title page, centred; a woodcut ornament and a small round medallion engraving between the imprint lines. No margin text. Digitiser's watermark "Digitized by Google" at lower right is excluded.
page.notes: Engraving: a small ornamental woodcut between the AB/AD lines and the imprint, and a round medallion engraving to its right; not transcribed as text. The year line reads "ANNO" followed by a reversed-C numeral, printed as MDCXVIII in the old form; the stroke pattern before "Iↄ" is partly obscured by a symbol and rendered as printed. Ink stamps and show-through at the right margin are excluded. Line "quinto salutis partæ se-" ends with a printed hyphen.
